correctness.rationale: For c=12..49 independent exact valuation computation gives s(c!)>c^2, while s(11!)=77<121 and s(12!)=231>144. For c>=50 Nagura at x=(c+1)/2,2c/3,5c/6 yields distinct q1,q2,q3 above c/2, each with odd v_q(c!)=1, so s(c!)>=q1q2q3>(5/18)c^3>c^2. For p>=13, s(pc!)=p s(c!) if p does not divide s(c!), and s(c!)/p>c^2/p>=p otherwise. For 2,3,5,7,11 the c=2,3,6,7,11 witnesses give s(pc!)<p. Independent script confirmed finite tail, endpoints, and p<=401,c<=500. Infinite proof rests on Nagura, not the script.
